name: Survey tile in Capricornus
blurb: A 0.3 degree patch 0.8 degrees north of the ecliptic in Capricornus, imaged by SPHEREx 20 times in 7 visits over 67 hours. Picked automatically by the survey because it was imaged often enough to follow a moving object.
summary_plain: 40 SPHEREx images of this patch taken over 2.8 days starting 2025-10-23, at wavelengths from 0.85 to 4.60 µm. The pipeline found 2 moving objects.
